Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Reducing PCOS-related issues, Improving body shape and energy levels
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Saturday

Meal_1: Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since vegetables are disliked, keep them simple, lightly cooked and in smaller portions initially.
Avoid boredom eating by drinking water or buttermilk first before taking snacks.
Morning sunlight exposure and regular yoga can improve PCOS symptoms and energy.
Keep dinner lighter and maintain consistent meal timing for better hormone balance.
